// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// The shape the PR5 widening permits, and the whole of it: closed string
// unions and pure helpers. No Prisma, no credentials, no address, no network.
// The vocabulary lives outside the ops tree because the mailer needs it too,
// and a file the ops tree imports is walked as ops code.
import { classifyMailResult, utcDay } from "@/lib/mailStatus";

export function todayLabel(status: number) {
  return `${utcDay(new Date())}: ${classifyMailResult(status)}`;
}
